profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Noveon Magnetics
profile.summary:
I am a full stack web developer experienced in Ruby- and Javascript-based frameworks. With a background in game development and 3D modeling, I am accustomed to using my creativity and design skills as well as quickly learning and adapting to new frameworks. 

Javascript | React | Rails | Ruby | HTML | CSS | SQL | Full-Stack Development

Github: github.com/reedanna

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Develops for and manages bespoke in-house Employee Dashboard for use by all company employees, using a Ruby on Rails, Typescript, and React-based codebase.
Designs, prioritizes, and implements new features suggested by the Dashboard’s top users.
Writes and fine-tunes scripts in Python and PHP for automated database management and uploading.
Provides fast, thorough, and specific code updates in response to submitted bug reports.

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description: Provided consulting intelligence on software, web, and database development for various clients. Acquired in-house certifications proving development expertise.

positions.title: Software Engineering Student
positions.description:
Attended Software Engineering bootcamp full-time and received Certificate of Completion. Completed the following projects:

Pokemon Battle Frontier:
A tool for conceptualizing and keeping track of Pokemon builds for the popular video game series, created over 3 weeks as a final project.

Video demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NWO0fKcTcqY
Github backend: https://github.com/reedanna/mod-5-backend
Github frontend: https://github.com/reedanna/mod-5-frontend

I10erary:
A vacation-planning app allowing users to create a day-by-day itinerary for their trips, co-created with Chris Torres.

Video demo: https://youtu.be/PDpr0DuhOuQ
Github: https://github.com/reedanna/i10erary

Trivia Tumble:
A command line interface game challenging the user to correctly answer trivia questions, co-created with Micah Mosley.

Video demo: https://youtu.be/50N3swVfJ3Y
Github: https://github.com/micahmosley/Trivia-Tumble

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description: Performed exploratory and scripted testing for Respawn Entertainment’s Apex Legends, with a focus on art and user interface quality.

positions.title: 3D Art Intern
positions.description: Modeled and textured environment assets for Raconteur’s Doggone. Collaborated with the art team to establish a unified art style for all assets.
